author: MandaloreGaming
description:
The System Shock remake finally released in 2023 after nearly a decade of development at Nightdive Studios and then got a large patch in the middle of me making this. It's supposedly so much like the original some players think it's *too* much like the original. But did they actually play the 1993 game? Either way SHODAN is back. Please clap.
